investigation.title: Detailed Results from the Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) March 2009 to December 2011

principal_investigators.name: Vedha Nayagam
principal_investigators.affiliation: National Center for Space Exploration Research

investigation.summary: The Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) was conducted aboard the International Space Station (ISS) in the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) using the Multi-User Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA). A total of 284 flight tests were conducted between March 2009 and December 2011 to investigate the burning and extinction behavior of isolated spherical fuel droplets in microgravity.
investigation.objectives: Investigate isolated spherical droplet combustion, determine d^2 burning rates, observe cool flame phenomena, and evaluate radiative and chemical kinetic extinction limits.
investigation.apparatus_description: Multi-User Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA) in the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) 100-liter chamber aboard the ISS.
